inputs.name: hand over from Risk Assessment to Acceptance Criteria

output.level_0: Risk findings contradict the acceptance criteria, causing rework and stakeholder disputes.
output.level_1: No explicit link exists between risk assessment outputs and the final acceptance criteria.
output.level_2: A team member manually maps risk items to acceptance criteria in a shared spreadsheet.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically validates that all high risks have corresponding acceptance criteria.
output.level_4: Governed workflows enforce traceability, ensuring every risk is addressed by a specific criterion.
